# Prevent repeated keypresses from reopening a draft twice

## What & Why
Recovery is activated from a keyboard-accessible button. Add a regression case for rapid repeated Enter or Space input to ensure one draft produces one form and one recovery result instead of duplicate or conflicting state.

## Done looks like
- Repeated keyboard activation does not create duplicate recovery notices or forms.
- The recovered draft values and success announcement remain stable after the repeated input.
